subject: Economic buyer & budget owner follow-up — Questech
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@questech.io>, Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@questech.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0500
Subject: Quick recap + ask: economic buyer & budget owner (Questech)

Hi Liam & Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a couple of asks to keep momentum: 

What we heard (short):
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + intelligent routing for enterprise accounts (500k+ MAU).
- Success metrics: 50% reduction in triage time, 30% CSAT lift on escalations, sub-200ms gen latency for in-app experiences.
- Timeline: pilot in Q1, scale in Q2 if pilot success criteria met.
- Technical/risk notes: data residency in us-east, SOC2 compliance required, procurement wants standard terms + standard DPAs.

Asks / next steps: 
1) Could you please confirm who the economic buyer will be for this initiative (the person who signs off on budget and ROI)?
2) Also need the budget owner / procurement contact (Finance or Procurement who executes SOW).
3) If you can, please introduce those folks on a short thread so we can share a one-pager + pricing ranges tailored to budget level.

I’ve attached the discovery notes and our proposed pilot outline for reference. Suggested next step: 30-min commercial alignment with the economic buyer + procurement; I’m available Wed 12/7 10–12 ET and Thu 12/8 2–4 ET.

Thanks — appreciate the time.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: Questech_discovery-notes.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@questech.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@questech.io>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: economic buyer & budget owner (Questech)

Hey Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. Looping in the right folks:

- Rajiv Singh (Head of Product) — rajiv.singh@questech.io — he will be the economic buyer for product initiatives like this.
- Procurement (procurement@questech.io) — procurement will handle SOW and commercial terms.
- Samantha Lee (Finance lead) — samantha.lee@questech.io — she handles budget approval for partner integrations.

Rajiv / Samantha / Procurement — Vivek and the Redwood team have put together an outline and pilot plan; they asked for a short commercial alignment and a pricing range to evaluate feasibility. Can we schedule a 30-min sync next week?

For context, procurement has requested our vendor questionnaire and an initial T&Cs doc; looping them in will speed that along. I’ve attached the procurement questionnaire so you know what they typically need.

Happy to jump on the call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sophie
Director, Customer Solutions | Questech

Attachment: Questech_procurement_questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Quick recap + ask: economic buyer & budget owner (Questech)

Thanks for the heads-up, Vivek — good call. Suggested plan to mobilize quickly: 

1) Build an "economic buyer packet" (one-pager + ROI sketch + pricing range) to share directly with Rajiv and Samantha. I can draft the pricing tiers (pilot / scaled / enterprise) based on the usage profile you captured.
2) Neha: please pull the SOC 2 summary, data residency notes, and short answers to the procurement questionnaire (we can reuse our standard sendable packet).
3) I'll prepare a short slide with expected ROI assumptions and a recommended pilot scope.

Timing: aim to have draft packet by EOD Mon 12/6 so Vivek can send to Rajiv/Samantha ahead of the proposed 12/7 call.

Vivek — want you to own the outreach to Rajiv + Samantha (once packet ready). Copy me on the thread; I'll join the first call for commercial alignment.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Exec_Summary_questech.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@questech.io>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@questech.io>
Cc: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@questech.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Intro + proposed 30-min alignment (Questech x Redwood)

Hi Rajiv & Samantha —

Thanks Sophie for the intro. Briefly — Redwood helps product and support teams ship LLM-powered features with predictable latency and costs while maintaining enterprise controls (SOC2, private deployments). We put together a short packet (one-pager + ROI sketch + pricing ranges) to help evaluate feasibility for a Q1 pilot; Marissa and Neha from my team are on copy.

Ask: would you be open to a 30-minute alignment call to confirm success metrics and budget range? Suggested times (ET):
- Wed 12/8 10–10:30am
- Wed 12/8 3–3:30pm
- Thu 12/9 11–11:30am

If none of those work, please suggest two windows and we'll follow. I’ve attached the exec packet for quick review — happy to send a short pricing addendum after you confirm target scale.

Thanks and looking forward to aligning,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
